samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: Write to Ms Brown at a local centre to ask about an online study workshop. Explain your interest, ask about arrangements and costs, and ask how to register.
requirementsVi: Nêu mục đích và nhu cầu.
Hỏi giờ, điều kiện, chi phí.
Hỏi cách đăng ký.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to ask for further information about an online study workshop. I saw the notice at the community centre and would like to know whether the session would be suitable for someone with limited experience.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chào người biết tên và nêu mục đích.

paragraphs.label: Nhu cầu
paragraphs.text: I am interested in online university classes because students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. I would like a practical introduction rather than a session that requires specialist knowledge.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích hoàn cảnh để người nhận tư vấn đúng.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi
paragraphs.text: Could you please confirm whether the session is on Saturday at nine in the morning and how long it lasts? I would also like to know the fee and whether materials are included. The notice mentions that participants will try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group; should I bring headphones or any other equipment?
paragraphs.noteVi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp về sắp xếp và chuẩn bị.

paragraphs.label: Đăng ký và kết
paragraphs.text:
Finally, could you explain how to register and whether there is a deadline? If places are limited, please let me know when I should apply.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỏi bước tiếp, cảm ơn và kết thư trang trọng.
